content.short: up is one of the larger decentralized exchanges operating on Robinhood Chain.
content.description: up runs exchange markets on Robinhood Chain and ranks among the chain's larger venues by value locked, across two deployed versions. Robinhood Chain's liquidity is still concentrated in a handful of venues, so a native exchange at this size handles a meaningful share of the chain's tokenized equity and crypto trading rather than competing at the margin.
content.meta: A native Robinhood Chain exchange ranking among the chain's larger venues by value locked.
